bass.tags: Industrial techno with heavy distortion and experimental sound design. A saturated, overdriven kick drum provides a rhythmic pulse at 130 BPM in 4/4 time. A resonant, low-frequency synth drone oscillates with a slow filter sweep. High-frequency metallic percussion hits occur on off-beats with short decay. A distorted, bit-crushed synth lead enters with a repetitive two-note sequence. The track features heavy compression and sidechaining to the kick drum. Industrial mechanical textures and white noise bursts are processed through a granular delay. The key is C minor. Sub-bass frequencies are prominent below 60Hz. A high-pass filter sweep gradually removes low-end frequencies during the transition.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted kick drum pulse, low-frequency resonant drone]

[Section A]
[metallic percussion hits on off-beats, bit-crushed synth lead enters]
[granular delay on mechanical textures]

[Section B]
[high-pass filter sweep on master bus, white noise bursts]
[sub-bass intensity increases]

drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A dusty, sampled drum break features a muffled kick and a crisp, slightly off-grid snare with a high-frequency roll-off. A Rhodes electric piano plays a repetitive four-bar progression of jazzy seventh chords with a soft tremolo effect and heavy saturation. A deep, rounded sub-bass follows the root notes of the piano chords with a slight slide between transitions. Vinyl crackle and hiss are layered throughout the arrangement. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor. A muted trumpet with a Harmon mute plays short, melodic fragments with significant reverb.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss, muffled drum break enters]

[Main Loop]
[Rhodes electric piano playing jazzy seventh chords]
[sub-bass enters with subtle slides]
[muted trumpet fragments with heavy reverb]

vocals.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar progression with a heavily overdriven tone. Drums feature a fast d-beat pattern with a prominent, dry snare and constant eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The recording has a lo-fi, DIY aesthetic with high-frequency saturation. Tempo is 185 BPM. Key is E minor. Time signature is 4/4.
vocals.prompt:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, d-beat drum pattern]

[Verse 1]
[shouted male vocals]
I see the walls closing in today
No matter what the people say [bass guitar enters with heavy overdrive]
Locked in a cage of my own design
Running out of breath and running out of time

[Chorus]
[guitar switches to higher register power chords]
Break the chains (break the chains)
No more pain (no more pain)
[crash cymbal accents]
I won't be a victim of your games

[Outro]
[feedback swell]
[final snare hit]
